dataFlow: UnifiedMantaModal calls uploadPreparedPair with the authenticated uploader UUID and sighting/manta/photo/edit UUIDs. Two immutable objects in manta-images: submissions/<user>/<sighting>/<manta>/<photo>/original.<ext> and prepared-<edit>.jpg.

photoPreparation returns id, path, storageBucket, originalPath, editTransform, and a full public url. Crop re-edit downloads originalPath through authenticated Storage, writes a new prepared path, retains logical identity and replaces url.

UnifiedMantaModal -> MantaDraft -> AddSightingPage mantas state -> handleSubmit directly serializes mantas into sighting_submissions.payload. Review hydration copies m.photos without normalization; reviewSave merges them back.
MantasList/photoDisplaySource/UnifiedMantaModal/Match submitted-photo viewer consume stored URL/preview directly. A one-line bucket flag change would break these already-stored public URLs.

My Contributions pending/rejected rows: payloadPhotos prefers stored non-blob url, otherwise builds getPublicUrl from path/bucket. Accepted/historical: loadContributionPhotos queries photos.storage_path/storage_bucket and converts to public URLs. Catalog details also use publicImage.

Commit Review delegates to base RPC. Provenance branch writes photo.id as pk_photo_uuid, path as storage_path, storageBucket, originalPath and transform; does not move/copy objects or use display url as storage identity. Legacy branch keeps its existing defaults. Nothing in this phase changes either branch.

Current permanent policy excludes submissions/ paths. Future approval creates permanent photos that still reference that namespace; permanent-read authorization must recognize a committed photos reference (including original path as appropriate), rather than rely only on namespace. SELECT relation visibility must be tested for active contributors and admins.

Historical thumbnail_url and catalog best-photo URLs are full public URLs; views and photo/catalog triggers propagate these. Normalize at display boundaries without rewriting historical rows; do not save signed URLs through best-photo selection into catalog metadata.

recommendation.chosen: Option A — single private manta-images bucket, later guarded transition
recommendation.optionA: No object moves, no new bucket, no provenance or commit mapping changes. Integrate the display helper across pending photos, summary/measurement/editor/Match, Browse cards/modals/thumbnails, My Contributions, Review, diagnostics/exports/duplicate tools. Preserve bucket/path metadata and old full public URLs. Replace broad permanent SELECT with active-authenticated access and recognize approved submission paths via committed photos references. Keep active own pending and active admin pending policies. Implement all readers and policy tests BEFORE flag flip.
recommendation.optionB: New private manta-submissions bucket requires upload bucket changes, current provenance validation/re-edit/base RPC bucket assumptions to change, and approval copy/move or mixed-bucket readers. Adds recoverability and immutable original/derivative concerns. Leaving approved manta-images public violates the no-anonymous-known-URL goal, so B alone is not acceptable.
recommendation.blastRadius: See exact sourceCallsites below, including passive thumbnail consumers, tests/types, server and script dependencies. Helpers alone do not cover every reader. No reader has been rewired in this phase.
recommendation.drone: drone-photo is public because Browse DroneSurveys/DronePhotosMapModal build public URLs. Service commit-drone-draft downloads temp-images and uploads drone-photo with a server client; private flags need not require moving objects. Add active-user/admin SELECT and convert the two public readers before making private. Existing SELECT targets anon only, so authenticated private signing is not guaranteed by that policy. Preserve service-role policy.
recommendation.temp: temp-images supports DronePhotosModal drafts, older manta photo modals/uploader, diagnostics and disabled ranked-match uploads. Contains 30 drone/, 62 diagnostics/, 548 other objects. Convert public readers and persisted drone draft URL display; replace PUBLIC read with explicit active/owner/admin coverage. Drone/<draft>/ paths do not encode user ownership; use trusted draft ownership relation, audit legacy paths, and do not guess ownership from filenames. Server/matcher URL consumers need explicit private access design; ranked matching stays disabled.
recommendation.contractor: No contractor-docs references in current frontend, functions or scripts; existing authenticated SELECT/INSERT match entire bucket and service access survives. Draft removes ONLY two anon policies. No source integration required for this removal. Authenticated policy does not enforce active-account or per-document ownership; document that separate risk, do not silently broaden this draft.
recommendation.other: calibration-images already uses one-hour signed URLs and admin-only Storage policies; preserve. csv-uploads currently admin listing only; pdfs empty and no ordinary-client policy. Do not change either.

draftHelper.behavior: Caller supplies explicit bucket/path and configured project URL. Accept canonical relative, bucket-prefixed, historical public endpoint/full same-project public URLs. Reject foreign/signed/blob/mismatched references. Validate authenticated user then call createSignedUrl under caller RLS. Return display URL only; no DB write/cache/state/public fallback.
draftHelper.limitations: Future consuming query/view must refresh on expiry and invalidate on account switch/logout; preserve durable metadata separately, never serialize a signed URL. Signed URLs are bearer links during their usable lifetime, not proof that every byte fetch requires a session. Already-downloaded/cached bytes cannot be recalled. For a stronger no-bearer-share requirement use authenticated downloads/blob display instead.
draftHelper.pending: Both Oct 3 photos have intact derivative/original references and can be normalized and signed under the existing owner/admin rules after integration. They remain displayable today because nothing changed. Making the bucket private now without integration would break stored public URLs.

runtimePlan: Before any future apply: fresh exact policies/flags/schema and row/object fingerprints, authenticated contributor/admin sessions supplied by Mark, exact rollback prepared; use only MantaTracker Development.app for local visual checks.

Low-risk contractor apply (NOT this phase): anon list/download/sign denied; anon upload denied using one unique disposable key, ensure no object exists afterward; if unexpectedly accepted, immediately remove the disposable object through authorized admin and report failure. Authenticated SELECT/INSERT continue; never use real contractor content in output.

Full privacy transition: test unauthenticated known public endpoints from all three former public buckets return no bytes, including a pending derivative and original. Test anon metadata/list/sign/upload denied; signed URLs intentionally grant temporary bearer access and must be assessed separately.

Active ordinary user: own pending original+derivative upload/read and crop re-edit; other user's uncommitted objects denied; existing Oct 3 two photos visible read-only in My Contributions; permanent historical and newly approved submission-namespace photos visible. Do not approve the real sighting to test this.

Admin: all pending photo evidence, original download, Match/catalog thumbnails, Review and calibration load; inactive users/admins denied. Preserve service-role processing. No permanent test objects; all write probes disposable and removed in same approved test.

URL lifecycle: direct and old stored full URL normalization, thumbnail vs full path, spaces/encoded characters, expiry refresh, logout/account switch, denied/error states, no signed URL persisted in submission/review/catalog or exported durable records.

After future transition: full regression and exact counts/fingerprints of catalog/sightings/mantas/photos/manta_sizes/sighting_submissions/biopsies and storage objects. No historical path rewrites. Current phase runs static tests only.
